projects.name: Eternal Flames
projects.summary: A full-stack timeline application combining client-side image processing, interactive 3D visuals, and performance-conscious data access.
contributions: Implemented in-browser face detection using MediaPipe and WebAssembly to automate image cropping without server-side processing.
Built a Three.js and WebGL particle system with dynamic tuning and asynchronous processing, targeting stable 60 FPS on lower-end devices.
Improved PostgreSQL access by replacing offset pagination with cursor-based pagination and adding HTTP caching.
Implemented authentication and database safeguards using NextAuth v5, Bcrypt password hashing, and parameterized SQL queries.

projects.name: Local Business Admin Dashboard
projects.summary: Contributed frontend and backend features to an administrative dashboard in collaboration with the core developer.
contributions: Implemented features and bug fixes in a Vue.js frontend and NestJS backend while collaborating directly with the core developer.

projects.name: The Green Mirage: Uncovering the Blueprint of a Resilient City
projects.summary: An analysis of environmental and economic indicators for the Microsoft Fabric Community Contest.
contributions: Analyzed environmental and economic datasets to identify factors associated with urban sustainability.
Used PySpark for data transformation and exploratory analysis to derive data-driven insights.

projects.name: eBay Mobile Purchase Automation
projects.summary: A mobile test-automation suite covering an end-to-end eBay purchase journey.
contributions: Developed automated coverage for authentication, product search, and checkout.
Structured the test framework using the Page Object Model to separate test logic from UI elements.
Implemented dynamic waits and synchronization strategies to improve reliability across varying network conditions.
